newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cresud cut to reduce.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cresud cut to reduce.

text.p: -- Robert Flemings said it cut its rating on Argentine agribusiness Credsud SA to reduce from hold.

-- In a February 14 report, analyst Jos Costa Buck praised the company's "ambitious expansion program, professional management team, healthy financial position, access to world-class technology, economies of scale (as well as) Argentina's agribusiness sector potential," but added that the stock had little room for appreciation.
-- The company's shares were unchanged at 1.98 pesos in Buenos Aires.
